text_block_list.text: Goodness me. What was that just now?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Why does it... feel like I've been
enveloped in
warmth?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
How strange... There's power welling up
from
deep inside of me, but I still feel so
calm.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
